report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the alert: gateway and order traces show OK checkout spans at 66ms, metrics show error_rate 0.0014 and p95 71ms, and logs show status 200. No error-rate or latency fault is observable, so no taxonomy candidate is supported. The order deployment record (3.2.8, 1526 min old, valid config) cannot establish causation. Handing off for operator review of the alert source.
missing_evidence: Telemetry window showing the actual elevated error rate and latency cited by the alert
Error/exception logs or failed spans from gateway or order during the alert window
Dependency-level metrics (inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) to test downstream-latency or timeout causes
Confirmation of alert source and time window; current observations may not overlap the incident
